what_happened: The job raised the agent ceiling from 8 to 16 and added recording of plan-group sizes per batch. The verifier rejected it at the final verdict with one major finding and no blocker. No checks failed and no acceptance criteria are listed as unmet. The finding: the `athena drain` help text in crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs:275 still says the ceiling is 8. That file was on the deliverables list but was not changed.
cause: The old value of the ceiling lives in more than one place: the config or code constant and the CLI help string. Nothing ties these to one source, and nothing makes the producer find every occurrence of the old number. The producer changed the constant and the recording, but no check looks for the old value in text that restates it. Only the verifier's reading of the diff caught the gap, at the final verdict. The checks pass because help text is not tested.
prevention: Build the help text from the same constant that sets the ceiling, so it cannot go stale. Add a test that runs `athena drain --help` and asserts it shows the current ceiling value. For other limit changes, run a check that greps the repo (code, help, docs) for the old value and fails if a stale mention remains outside the changelog.
proposed_request: Make the `athena drain` help text in crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs state the agent ceiling from the same constant or config default that enforces it (now 16), not a hard-coded number. Add a test that runs the drain help output and fails if it does not contain that current ceiling value. Also search the repo's code, docs and help text for any other mention of the old ceiling of 8 and update it to match. Add a CHANGELOG entry under Fixed. Acceptance: the help text shows 16; the new test fails if the help text and the ceiling disagree; no stale mention of 8 as the ceiling remains outside the changelog.
